lines.gurmukhi: ਵਖਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ਸੁ ਬੰਦਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: vakhat veechaare s ba(n)daa hoi ||
lines.translation: One who reflects upon his allotted span of life, becomes the slave of God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਹੈ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kudarat hai keemat nahee paai ||
lines.translation: The value of the Creative Power of the Universe cannot be known.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਇ ਤ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa keemat paai ta kahee na jaai ||
lines.translation: Even if its value were known, it could not be described.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰੈ ਸਰੀਅਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sarai sareeat karahi beechaar ||
lines.translation: Some think about religious rituals and regulations,

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਕੈਸੇ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin boojhe kaise paavahi paar ||
lines.translation: but without understanding, how can they cross over to the other side?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਦਕੁ ਕਰਿ ਸਿਜਦਾ ਮਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਖਸੂਦੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sidak kar sijadaa man kar makhasood ||
lines.translation: Let sincere faith be your bowing in prayer, and let the conquest of your mind be your objective in life.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਧਿਰਿ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਿਹ ਧਿਰਿ ਮਉਜੂਦੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jih dhir dekhaa tih dhir maujood ||1||
lines.translation: Wherever I look, there I see God's Presence. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਭਾ ਏਵ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾ ਨੇੜੈ ਨਾ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur sabhaa ev na paaeeai naa neRai naa door ||
lines.translation: The Society of the Guru is not obtained like this, by trying to be near or far away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤਾਂ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਹੈ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak satigur taa(n) milai jaa man rahai hadoor ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, you shall meet the True Guru, if your mind remains in His Presence. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਪਤ ਦੀਪ ਸਪਤ ਸਾਗਰਾ ਨਵ ਖੰਡ ਚਾਰਿ ਵੇਦ ਦਸ ਅਸਟ ਪੁਰਾਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sapat deep sapat saagaraa nav kha(n)d chaar ved das asat puraanaa ||
lines.translation: The seven islands, seven seas, nine continents, four Vedas and eighteen Puraanas

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਭਨਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਤੂੰ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਭਨਾ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har sabhanaa vich too(n) varatadaa har sabhanaa bhaanaa ||
lines.translation: O Lord, You pervade and permeate all. Lord, everyone loves You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਤੁਝੈ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਰਗ ਪਾਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh tujhai dhiaavahi jee ja(n)t har saarag paanaa ||
lines.translation: All beings and creatures meditate on You, Lord. You hold the earth in Your Hands.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧਦੇ ਤਿਨ ਹਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo guramukh har aaraadhade tin hau kurabaanaa ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to those Gurmukhs who worship and adore the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਕਰਿ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਣਾ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) aape aap varatadaa kar choj vidaanaa ||4||
lines.translation: You Yourself are All-pervading; You stage this wondrous drama! ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲਉ ਮਸਾਜਨੀ ਕਿਆ ਸਦਾਈਐ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹੀ ਲਿਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kalau masaajanee kiaa sadaaeeai hiradai hee likh lehu ||
lines.translation: Why ask for a pen, and why ask for ink? Write within your heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਹੈ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਨ ਤੂਟਸਿ ਨੇਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa saahib kai ra(n)g rahai kabahoo(n) na tootas nehu ||
lines.translation: Remain immersed forever in the Love of your Lord and Master, and your love for Him shall never break.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲਉ ਮਸਾਜਨੀ ਜਾਇਸੀ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਭੀ ਨਾਲੇ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kalau masaajanee jaaisee likhiaa bhee naale jaai ||
lines.translation: Pen and ink shall pass away, along with what has been written.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਇਸੀ ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਛੋਡੀ ਸਚੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sah preet na jaaisee jo dhur chhodee sachai paai ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Love of your Husband Lord shall never perish. The True Lord has bestowed it, as it was pre-ordained. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਦਰੀ ਆਵਦਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਚਲਈ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਕੋ ਵਿਉਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: nadaree aavadaa naal na chalaee vekhahu ko viupaai ||
lines.translation: That which is seen, shall not go along with you. What does it take to make you see this?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਸਚਿ ਰਹਹੁ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur sach driRaaiaa sach rahahu liv laai ||
lines.translation: The True Guru has implanted the True Name within; remain lovingly absorbed in the True One.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦੀ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਕਰਮੀ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sabadee sach hai karamee palai paai ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Word of His Shabad is True. By His Grace, it is obtained. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਇਕੁ ਤੂੰ ਤੂੰ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਭੇਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: har a(n)dar baahar ik too(n) too(n) jaanahi bhet ||
lines.translation: O Lord, You are inside and outside as well. You are the Knower of secrets.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕੀਚੈ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo keechai so har jaanadaa mere man har chet ||
lines.translation: Whatever anyone does, the Lord knows. O my mind, think of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਡਰੈ ਜਿ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਵਦਾ ਧਰਮੀ ਵਿਗਸੇਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: so darai j paap kamaavadaa dharamee vigaset ||
lines.translation: The one who commits sins lives in fear, while the one who lives righteously rejoices.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਸਚਾ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਆਉ ਸਚੁ ਤਾ ਡਰੀਐ ਕੇਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) sachaa aap niaau sach taa dareeai ket ||
lines.translation: O Lord, You Yourself are True, and True is Your Justice. Why should anyone be afraid?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਸੇ ਸਚਿ ਰਲੇਤੁ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: jinaa naanak sach pachhaaniaa se sach ralet ||5||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those who recognize the True Lord are blended with the True One. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲਮ ਜਲਉ ਸਣੁ ਮਸਵਾਣੀਐ ਕਾਗਦੁ ਭੀ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kalam jalau san masavaaneeai kaagad bhee jal jaau ||
lines.translation: Burn the pen, and burn the ink; burn the paper as well.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਿਖਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਜਲਿ ਬਲਉ ਜਿਨਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: likhan vaalaa jal balau jin likhiaa doojaa bhaau ||
lines.translation: Burn the writer who writes in the love of duality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak poorab likhiaa kamaavanaa avar na karanaa jaai ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, people do what is pre-ordained; they cannot do anything else. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਰੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਪੜਣਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: hor kooR paRanaa kooR bolanaa maaiaa naal piaar ||
lines.translation: False is other reading, and false is other speaking, in the love of Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਥਿਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak vin naavai ko thir nahee paR paR hoi khuaar ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, without the Name, nothing is permanent; those who read and read are ruined. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵਡੀ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kee vadiaaee vadee hai har keeratan har kaa ||
lines.translation: Great is the Greatness of the Lord, and the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵਡੀ ਹੈ ਜਾ ਨਿਆਉ ਹੈ ਧਰਮ ਕਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kee vadiaaee vadee hai jaa niaau hai dharam kaa ||
lines.translation: Great is the Greatness of the Lord; His Justice is totally Righteous.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵਡੀ ਹੈ ਜਾ ਫਲੁ ਹੈ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kee vadiaaee vadee hai jaa phal hai jee kaa ||
lines.translation: Great is the Greatness of the Lord; people receive the fruits of the soul.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵਡੀ ਹੈ ਜਾ ਨ ਸੁਣਈ ਕਹਿਆ ਚੁਗਲ ਕਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kee vadiaaee vadee hai jaa na sunaee kahiaa chugal kaa ||
lines.translation: Great is the Greatness of the Lord; He does not hear the words of the back-biters.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵਡੀ ਹੈ ਅਪੁਛਿਆ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਵਕਾ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: har kee vadiaaee vadee hai apuchhiaa daan devakaa ||6||
lines.translation: Great is the Greatness of the Lord; He gives His Gifts without being asked. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤੀ ਸਭ ਮੁਈ ਸੰਪਉ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau hau karatee sabh muee sa(n)pau kisai na naal ||
lines.translation: Those who act in ego shall all die. Their worldly possessions shall not go along with them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਭ ਜੋਹੀ ਜਮਕਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: doojai bhaai dukh paaiaa sabh johee jamakaal ||
lines.translation: Because of their love of duality, they suffer in pain. The Messenger of Death is watching all.
